mapper.select: SELECT er.id, er.application_id, s.name AS student_name, s.student_no AS student_no, gt.type_name AS type_name, er.total_score, er.score_rank, CASE WHEN ga.special_type > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_special, gl.level_name, gl.amount AS grant_amount, er.evaluate_time, sr.economic_score, sr.family_burden_score, sr.special_hardship_score, sr.disaster_score FROM evaluation_result er INNER JOIN grant_application ga ON er.application_id = ga.id INNER JOIN student s ON er.student_id = s.id INNER JOIN grant_type gt ON ga.type_id = gt.id LEFT JOIN grant_level gl ON er.level_id = gl.id LEFT JOIN score_record sr ON er.application_id = sr.application_id WHERE er.id = #{id}
SELECT s.counselor_id FROM evaluation_result er INNER JOIN grant_application ga ON er.application_id = ga.id INNER JOIN student s ON ga.student_id = s.id WHERE er.id = #{id}
